locations.name: Bretonnia
locations.role: Distant western feudal/chivalric realm or region; exact political scope still unresolved.
Large capital hosting the royal court, tournament, markets, guilds, and cathedral.
Seat of King Charles and initial lodging/audience site for the Dragon Rider delegation.
Center of the Church's authority and destination of the recovered Holy Relic.
Site of jousts and associated ceremonial events.
Undecided location where the Holy Relic is recovered.
Fortress in which King Charles, Alaric, and allied forces are trapped during Lothar's siege.
Territory proposed as a final royal reward to Alaric and the Dragon Rider Order; not yet accepted canon.
